name: Chili Beef Meatballs with Spicy Tomato-Pepper Sauce & Corn Tortillas

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a large baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.

Place beef, bread crumbs, eggs, and spices in a medium bowl. Using your hands, mix well to combine. Using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the mixture into meatballs and transfer to the baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g lean ground beef
2 eggs
chili powder
1 tsp cumin, ground
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place meatballs in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until golden and cooked through, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 green bell peppers
2 jalapeño peppers
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Place in a clean medium bowl.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice and add to the bowl with the bell pepper. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, cilantro, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
chili powder
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes and tomato sauce to the pot, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens slightly, 5-6 minutes more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (411 g) cans diced tomatoes
2 (221 g) cans tomato sauce

instructions.primary_message: When the meatballs are done, add to the pot with the sauce and stir once more to combine.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide meatballs between plates or bowls. Top with reserved cilantro and serve with tortillas on the side. Enjoy!
